title: DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated August 17, 2026, relative to Contract No. C-137882 Between
text:
[3. CONSENT AGENDA ITEMS]
DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated August 17, 2026, relative to Contract No. C-137882 Between
  the City of Los Angeles and Didi Hirsch Psychiatric Service DBA Didi Hirsch Mental Health
  Services for Mental Health Call Diversion Services, as set forth.  [BPC #26-257]

  Recommendation(s) for Board action:

  APPROVE the Department’s report and TRANSMIT to the Mayor and City Council.
summary: Approves contract with Didi Hirsch Mental Health Services for mental health call diversion services.
